public documentation, reports, security review or audit artifacts, mainnet deployments, script hashes, schemas, and integration guides
request.recipient: Dano Finance, with Minswap Labs serving as budget administrator
request.what: Treasury withdrawal to fund Dano Finance's DeFi Kernel registry work, Spot Leverage Order Book, American Options Market-Making Pools, and Composable DeFi Transaction Builder SDK.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 3,333,000 ADA, consisting of 3,300,000 ADA for delivery and 33,000 ADA for a 1% budget administration fee.

Dano Finance will improve defikernel.org and the DeFi Kernel registry so builders can submit compatible smart contracts and publish metadata such as script hashes, schemas, integration steps, audit status, TVL references, and discovery mechanisms.
The proposal will deliver two DeFi Kernel-compatible primitives, a Spot Leverage Order Book and American Options Market-Making Pools, plus a Composable DeFi Transaction Builder SDK.
Dano Finance currently has approximately USD 18M in TVL and more than 10,000 on-chain transactions.
Minswap Labs will serve as budget administrator for fund administration, milestone review, and accountability.

The work is divided into four work packages with milestone deliverables, including testnet deployments, security review or audit reports, issue resolution, mainnet releases, public reporting, and integration documentation.
The Spot Leverage Order Book KPI targets at least USD 1,000,000 in rolling 30-day trading volume within 90 days of mainnet launch, measured using public on-chain data.
The American Options Protocol KPI targets at least USD 1,000,000 in rolling 30-day option notional volume within 90 days of mainnet launch, measured using public on-chain data.
Unused or unearned funds are to remain unspent or be returned to the Cardano Treasury according to the administrator's process.

Dano Finance will return 5% of protocol fees generated by the Treasury-funded Spot Leverage Order Book and American Options contracts for 12 months after mainnet launch, after direct costs and reported publicly.

summary: The proposal seeks 3,333,000 ADA for DeFi Kernel registry infrastructure, two DeFi protocols, and an SDK, with milestone reporting, security review requirements, Minswap Labs administration, KPI targets, unused-fund handling, and a limited protocol-fee return commitment.
